reviews.text: Good service and in Spanish
They are friendly, helpful and the Dr. Is very patience, knowledgeable and honest. Recommend for all your dogs.

I took my dog for his annual checkup in Sept. It was such a good experience. He loved everyone there and was completely relaxed and cooperative through the whole check up (including the shots.)
Update: we went in for his 2nd annual checkup last week and had a great experience. I'm so happy we've found a good fit.
The veterinarians are so nice and gave my kitten excellent care :). Prices for vaccines are also reasonable.

I have three dogs and their was a point where two of my three dogs needed care and I didn't have a pre-booked appointment. The staff and doctor were kind to allow my dogs to be seen! Thank you for your passion and compassion! Highly recommend!

Dr. Ali is one of the nicest vets I've met. Brought my dog in as she was sick. He took great care of her and suggested what her diet needed to be. I'll be forever grateful. She's having surgery for her teeth this week and I know she'll be in excellent hands.
This is my favorite vet - hands down. Doctor ali is warm, friendly, engaging and very knowledgeable. And prices are very reasonable.

Dr. Ali and his team made saying goodbye to my Pantera much more tolerable. They gave us SO much time with her and we didn't feel rushed. It meant so much. It was my first time putting down a fur baby. I could tell Dr. Ali was sad too and that broke me. I wanted to thank him but I couldn't get words out. I admire the work you all do and wish I could monetarily compensate you all. I can't imagine constantly dealing with this type of of heartache. I'm so glad we have Dr. Ali and his team in the neighborhood.

Excellent clinic for pets!
The staff is very attentive and kind. They treat their patients with great care and respect. I am always very grateful to this veterinary clinic for treating my two babies with such kindness and special care.

Friendly and affordable neighborhood vet! Everyone was super nice and Dr. Ali was so kind and patient.  Apt was not rushed! A stray feral kitten showed up at my house emaciated and with an abscess on her paw pad.  The clinic was booked out until next week, but the front desk called me more than once to get her in earlier since I put her on the waitlist.  So just know, they will call you if they have an opening!  Kitten got her exam, dewormer, and 10 days of antibiotics for $85 - which is a FRACTION of the cost I have paid at other places.  Just the exam alone by a dr would cost that at other clinics not counting any other treatment.  They truly offer affordable care an it's so nice to have a neighborhood vet for our Oak Cliff community.
The tech Jocelyne did an amazing job with attending us. The vet also was extremely patient and gentle with my pet. Overall, the whole experience was smooth.
Failed to inform me that a microchip and vaccine would cost me $75 EACH.
Dr. Ali was great with my cat and super sweet to her! He listened to and addressed all my concerns. Before coming here, I had struggled to find a veterinary practice I liked in the area.

Got us in as a same day walk in without much waiting at all. Everyone from reception to nurse to doctor were incredibly friendly, calm, and knowledgeable. Cost was average. Plenty of seating. Doctor came in with candy for the kids which was a sweet gesture. Everything was explained thorough and clearly without rush. Costs were explained. 10/10 couldn’t have been a better experience.

I was very disappointed with my experience. The visit lasted less than 10 minutes, and I primarily went in for flea medication, physical needed prior to Rx. The vet barely examined my dog he quickly ran his hands through his fur, briefly used a stethoscope, and simply said my dog “sounds healthy and looks good.” When I asked what the physical exam actually consisted of, he explained they only do a basic exam and no labs, but honestly it didn’t feel like my pup was properly checked at all. I even asked whether I would still be charged the $60 exam fee given how minimal the visit was, and he said yes. In the end, I paid $92 total for a single flea/tick pill and a very rushed appointment. I’m honestly surprised they have so many customers based on the level of care and value I experienced.
Love this place.

My wife took our dog in today for his shot, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience. The staff—especially at the front desk—came across as rude and dismissive. She felt talked over and wasn’t given the chance to ask questions, which made the visit frustrating and uncomfortable.

We came here based on a recommendation and were expecting a much better level of care and professionalism. Sadly, that wasn’t the case. There seems to be a real lack of customer service training, and it shows in how clients are treated.

We won’t be returning. Very upsetting experience overall.

Dr Ali and the staff at Edgefield Animal Clinic are exceptional in professionalism and pet care. Every time I have an appointment at the clinic they are providing care for others animals which is extraordinary. My pets included. Everything from simple vaccinations to end of life is handled with the utmost importance and thoughtfulness. As a pet owner, that care and honor of the relationship of caregiver to pet makes me so grateful. Thank you!

The staff is so helpful.
The doctor is awesome.
Staff and vet were very helpful and informative. Definitely recommend for any of your pets needs. I will be back again!

They were immediate to help a dog that was hit by a car. She had passed before I arrived to the clinic unfortunately. I wasn’t sure and wanted to be sure before I assumed she was gone. She wasn’t my dog and they were nice enough to take care of her after her passing.  Thank you for your help and efforts that day.

My first time here and i was expecting a better experience.  Prices are affordable, doctor was ok but front desk staff member can definitely do better customer service. There was this girl writing me a prescription that after i asked a couple of questions she got short and rude even saying ' like i said sir'
They can definitely do better with customer service.
Will not recommend or visit again.
This place is no-frills, but the veterinarian and staff are kind and knowledgeable. They don’t charge the how much do you love your pet fee, they’re just here to help.
Very friendly and helpful staff and vet. Any time I need something, they are quick to respond and work with me to get the best care for my senior cat.
Worked with two docs on our cat's visits and both were great!  The vet techs were equally as great, too!  Highly recommend going here for any of your pet friends' needs.

Today’s visit was extremely disappointing. I asked for a statement about the medications and the purpose of the visit so I could explain everything to my husband, and the staff member responded rudely, even saying, “Well yes, if you can read it and understand it.” She also interrupted me twice while I was still on the phone and then I was moved to another room without explanation.

There was also confusion about the medications. I was given four prescriptions, and after checking prices at home, it appears I was overcharged by about $100.

This entire visit felt unprofessional, disrespectful, and overpriced.

Please get your prescriptions and take the to a pharmacy . My first vet visit was a fail.
The doctor is excellent. My cat recovered very quickly from her spay operation. The staff is lovely. Can't say enough good things.
The doctor and the staff are amazing. I have been coming here for years now and the service is always amazing.
Knowledgeable and caring doctor and staff providing excellent, professional pet care.  Best in town!
Grat service even if it was just to know that my cat has no chance of surviving, I will be bringing my other cats to get them vaccinated thow, the staff is Allright.

I took my dog in just over a year ago to get a second opinion. My previous clinic could not pinpoint why he had been coughing so much and suggested I do a CT scan. A neighbor told me about Dr Ali, and I brought him in. He examined him thoroughly and with the utmost confidence provided a diagnosis and treatment plan. In the following weeks, my dogs cough subsided, and I was so relieved.
He is now our primary Veterinarian. The entire staff at the clinic is so wonderful and caring. They quickly get you in during emergencies and follow up. On top of that, the fees are very reasonable in comparison to other clinics.
My dog is my child, and I put all my trust in this clinic and so should you!
Love this staff and clinic.
Wonderful staff and a very friendly and welcoming place to take your pets. Compared to other clinics, their prices are very reasonable. 😊 …

Dr. Ali and his staff are wonderful.  We had to take our eldest for euthanasia and there are no other clinics with the compassion he and his staff have.  They made a horrible situation as good as anyone can.  Thanks!!!

I went on July 5, 2025. My dog ​​was very ill.
They refused to treat him because it was by appointment only.
If they had checked him, he might have lived.
He died en route to another clinic.
They don't care about animal welfare.
For me, my pet was someone important in my life, not just an animal.
I considered him part of the family.
If they truly cared about animals, they would have treated him.
Terrible place

Around March was time for my boy Kiko to get his annual shots and check up, and we noticed all this time,  there was a vet super close. I called and they actually said it could be done the same day, but we were scheduling for another day.

I was actually suprised how quick the staff responded to me because I am so used to waiting, haha. They were very polite on the other end too!

As for my vet visit, very satisfied. It also helped that for a check up and annual vaccines, I paid less than $100. They also prescribed some eye drops for allergies to concerns i brought up regarding a runny eye.

I had to visit again around May because Kiko was vomiting a lot and the Doctor was able to help us get him back to normal, giving him two shots, some medication,  and prescribed food for less than $120.

I would have paid more elsewhere and probably still have my poor Kiko vomiting, but this vet goes straight to the problem and fixes it! I love that! And to think it was this close to me all this time!
